title: Ewan McGregor on Returning as Obi-Wan Kenobi: 'Come on, I'm Ready Whenever They Are'
text:
Ewan McGregor expressed frustration with the pace of development at Lucasfilm and his eagerness to reprise the role of Obi-Wan Kenobi. He believes the roughly ten-year gap between the series finale and the original Star Wars film offers rich storytelling potential worth exploring.
Ewan McGregor expressed frustration with the pace of development at Lucasfilm, stating his eagerness to reprise the role of Obi-Wan Kenobi. He believes the roughly ten-year gap between the series finale and the original Star Wars film offers rich storytelling potential worth exploring.
McGregor described the ending of the 2022 Disney+ miniseries as a natural launching point and highlighted the narrative gap that remains unexplored on screen. The actor wants to tell the stories that fill the space between Obi-Wan's departure from Luke Skywalker and his reappearance in the 1977 film Star Wars. McGregor suggested this could become a long-term commitment across multiple projects and wants to spend the rest of his career telling these stories through series or films.
He noted a practical timeline that supports continued involvement with the character, stating he has ten years before he reaches Alec Guinness's age. McGregor directly appealed to the studio, saying 'So come on, Disney.
' Lucasfilm president Kathleen Kennedy previously stated that a second season was not in active development
